repos.name: PyExe-Forge
repos.description: PyExeForge: A sleek, user-friendly GUI tool for converting Python scripts to standalone executables. Features dark emerald theme, real-time progress tracking, and simple one-click conversion. Perfect for developers and educators.

repos.name: EpicFreeGamesClaimer
repos.description: Automated tool to claim free Epic Games Store games. Never miss a free game again! Automatically detects and claims available free games using Selenium WebDriver. Set it up once, claim games forever.

repos.name: ChromeFlow
repos.description: A lightweight, Chrome-inspired browser interface built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features tabs, bookmarks, settings panel, and familiar Chrome UI elements. Perfect for embedded browsers or custom web applications.

repos.name: TradeSight-Dashboard
repos.description: A comprehensive real-time trading dashboard combining market data, social sentiment, news analysis, and pattern recognition. Features dark mode, API integrations, and multi-platform support for informed trading decisions.

repos.name: Exe-Decompiler
repos.description: A powerful GUI tool for decompiling and analyzing Electron-based .exe applications. Features ASAR extraction, source map analysis, and live modifications with recompilation support. Built for developers and security researchers.

repos.name: Context_Menu_Fixer
repos.description: > ContextMenuFixer is a Python tool designed to repair and restore Windows right-click context menus by fixing registry entries, clearing icon caches, and running system file checks. Easily restore your context menus with administrative privileges.

repos.name: Nexus_Ai_Streaming_Platform
repos.description: 🚀 Nexus AI: Next-gen streaming platform with AI-powered features including real-time translation, smart content discovery, and engagement analytics. Built with vanilla JS, CSS3, and HTML5. Currently in Phase 1 development. Join us in shaping the future of streaming!

repos.name: QuickDevTemplates
repos.description: 🚀 Windows context menu utility for developers to instantly create common development files (README, HTML, CSS, JS) with pre-filled templates. Streamline your project setup with just a right-click!

repos.name: GitSwift
repos.description: GitSwift is a user-friendly GUI tool that simplifies uploading your local projects to GitHub. Manage your tokens securely, create repositories, and seamlessly upload files with ease. Perfect for developers seeking an efficient way to host their code.

repos.name: kick_auto-refresh
repos.description: 🎮 Kick Auto Refresh Plus: Smart Chrome extension that automatically refreshes Kick.com streams during connection issues. Features ML-powered detection, multi-stream support, and advanced bot protection. Never miss a moment of your favorite streams!

repos.name: TikTok-Profile-Archiver
repos.description: Comprehensive TikTok profile backup tool. Archives videos, profile info, and metadata locally. Supports multiple accounts, handles private videos, and uses existing Chrome profiles. Perfect for content creators and archivists.

repos.name: APK-MobileStructure
repos.description: APK-MobileStructure: Standardize Android & Flutter projects with one command. Organizes directories, creates documentation, sets up CI/CD workflows. Includes Python script & Windows batch file for cross-platform use. Transform messy projects into professional codebases!

repos.name: IMEI_Lookup
repos.description: A modern IMEI lookup tool with PIN authentication, paid/free device checks, and IMEI calculator. Features responsive UI, sound effects, and multi-user support. Built with vanilla JS/CSS for phone retailers and repair shops. MIT License.

repos.name: GameMAC-Shield
repos.description: A sleek GUI tool for gamers to manage MAC addresses across different gaming platforms. Bypass hardware bans, protect privacy, and manage network identities. Features platform presets and one-click MAC randomization.

repos.name: MindfulShift-2025
repos.description: MindfulShift 2025 is a comprehensive personal transformation tool that helps you detox your life across 5 key dimensions: People, Places, Personal Growth, Professional Development, and Purpose. Built with Python for a seamless journey to your best self.

repos.name: GitSwift_Update
repos.description: GitSwift_update: A modern GUI tool for Git repository management. Streamlines documentation updates, changelog tracking, and GitHub issue creation. Perfect for developers maintaining consistent repository documentation.

repos.name: ChatGPT-Recipe_Studio
repos.description: ChatGPT Recipe Studiois for creating and managing ChatGPT "recipes" - preset text processing patterns for rephrasing, summarizing, replying, and email creation. Built with Python & PyQt6, it offers a clean interface to save and reuse your most effective GPT prompts.Length: 214 characters

repos.name: will-you-be-mine
repos.description: A playful, interactive web app for asking someone out on a date. Features a surprise loading screen, animated envelope, and a "no" button that runs away. Built with python and HTML and includes cloud notification system. 💌✨

repos.name: ExportYT_Chrome-Extension
repos.description: A native Chrome extension for seamless YouTube downloads. Download videos (144p-8K), audio (64kbps-320kbps), and transcripts directly in Chrome. Features custom categories and channel organization. No external software needed.

repos.name: iDevice-Jailbreak_Assistant
repos.description: One-click iOS jailbreak setup assistant that automates device detection, dependency installation, and jailbreak preparation. Supports multiple iOS versions and provides step-by-step guidance for a seamless jailbreaking experience.

repos.name: CleanupRepo
repos.description: CleanupRepo: A powerful Python tool for restructuring project repositories. Archive, reorganize, and restore files according to defined templates. Perfect for standardizing project structures across teams.

repos.name: Fortnite_LowPing
repos.description: 🎮 Fortnite Network Optimizer with auto-reversing capability. Reduces ping, optimizes network settings, and includes bot lobby features. Light version for in-game tweaking, full version for aggressive optimization.

repos.name: Twitch-Reimburse_Community-Channel-Points
repos.description: Automated Twitch channel points collector with Chrome extension integration. Watch multiple streams simultaneously, collect channel points automatically, and manage your points through a clean interface. Built with Python & Selenium.

repos.name: Force-Quit
repos.description: 🔴 Force-Quit: A Windows utility that safely terminates all non-essential processes with one click. Perfect for quickly freeing up system resources or closing frozen applications. Runs with admin privileges for maximum effectiveness.

repos.name: Fortnite-StreamCompanion
repos.description: A comprehensive desktop tool for Fortnite streamers and content creators. Features stream integration, stat tracking, VOD review, replay management, and custom overlays. Built with Python/Tkinter.

repos.name: rclone_GUI
repos.description: A user-friendly GUI wrapper for RClone, simplifying cloud backup operations. Features Google Drive integration, drag-and-drop folder selection, and real-time sync progress. Makes cloud backups accessible without command-line knowledge. Built with PyQt5.

repos.name: WindowMouseTracker
repos.description: Real-time mouse coordinate tracker that displays relative cursor positions within active windows. Perfect for UI automation, testing, and development. Features dark mode and hotkey toggle (Alt+'). Windows OS compatible.

repos.name: PhoenixRestore
repos.description: 🔄 Professional-grade file recovery tool with GUI interface. Features quick & deep scanning, preview capabilities, and system tray integration. Recover deleted files with ease using an intuitive dark-themed interface.

repos.name: GVTech-HUB_ChatGPT
repos.description: GVTech-HUB_ChatGPT: A powerful desktop toolkit for managing ChatGPT interactions. Create custom recipes for text processing, summarization, and content generation. Features an intuitive PyQt6 interface with reusable AI patterns.

repos.name: PyDoctor
repos.description: 🔧 PyDoctor: A comprehensive Python environment diagnostic and repair tool. Automatically detects and fixes environment issues, verifies installations, and provides detailed system analysis.

repos.name: GitGuardian
repos.description: A PyQt5-based GUI tool that simplifies GitHub repository creation and project uploads while automatically handling licensing, README generation, and intellectual property protection documentation.

repos.name: SmartDisk_Sentinel
repos.description: SmartDisk Sentinel: An intelligent storage optimization tool that helps identify and manage unused files, large media, and old downloads. Features workstation mode for batch processing and smart recommendations for efficient disk cleanup.

repos.name: UBIF-DiagnoseMe
repos.description: RepairRx: A comprehensive diagnostic suite for mobile device technicians. Streamlines device check-in, testing, and repair workflows with an intuitive GUI interface. Supports iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, and other Android devices.

repos.name: Workspace_Cleanup
repos.description: 🗂️ Automatically organizes Desktop & Downloads folders into dated archives. Keeps your workspace clean by moving files into timestamped folders while maintaining file history. Works with OneDrive & local folders. Windows/Mac/Linux compatible.

repos.name: GDrive-Direct-Linker
repos.description: A lightweight web tool that converts Google Drive sharing links into direct download links. Features dark mode, one-click conversion, and automatic clipboard copy. Perfect for educators, content creators, and anyone sharing files via Google Drive.

repos.name: Smart_Text_Expander
repos.description: Smart Text Expander: A smart text expansion tool that automates the insertion of frequently used phrases and snippets. Boost your productivity by managing and expanding trigger words seamlessly across applications. Built with Python and PySide6.

repos.name: construction-portfolio-project
repos.description: Portfolio: A professional construction company website demo featuring responsive design, contact forms, and client questionnaires. Built with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript for portfolio demonstration.

repos.name: twitch_auto-refresh
repos.description: 🎮 Twitch Auto Refresh Plus: Smart Chrome extension that automatically refreshes Twitch.com streams during connection issues. Features ML-powered detection, multi-stream support, and advanced inactivity/bot protection. Never miss a moment of your favorite streams!

repos.name: Identity-Insight-ID-Check
repos.description: Identity Insight is a comprehensive tool for conducting background checks and identity verification. It aggregates data from social media, public records, and more to provide detailed reports. Ideal for security professionals and researchers.

repos.name: QuickNav
repos.description: QuickNav: A Chrome extension that lets you instantly navigate to your favorite websites using customizable keyboard shortcuts. Boost productivity by accessing frequently visited URLs with just two keystrokes! ⚡️

repos.name: PyLibPro
repos.description: 🛠️ PyLibPro: A streamlined Python library installer for ML/AI development. Interactive CLI for managing TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn & more. Install by category or individually. Perfect for data science setup & teaching environments.

repos.name: MacroFlow-Studio
repos.description: MacroFlow Studio: A visual automation suite combining reference point capture and macro sequencing. Create reliable automated workflows using visual anchors, coordinates, and web elements. Perfect for UI testing and process automation.

repos.name: NotepadDarkify
repos.description: A simple Python utility to enable dark mode in Windows Notepad by modifying registry settings. Reduces eye strain during night-time editing with a clean black background and white text.

repos.name: SocialSync
repos.description: SocialSync: A unified social media management platform for scheduling, posting, and analyzing content across multiple platforms. Features dark mode UI, real-time previews, and platform-specific optimization guides.

repos.name: X-Privacy-Automator
repos.description: Automate privacy settings for Twitter posts in bulk. This tool helps users quickly modify reply settings to "Only you" for multiple tweets at once, saving time and enhancing privacy management for Twitter accounts.

repos.name: tiktok-playlist-backup
repos.description: A Python tool to backup TikTok collections/playlists, saving videos and metadata locally. Uses your Chrome profile to access TikTok, preserving your login session and capturing both public and authenticated content.

repos.name: UniversalMelody
repos.description: A versatile music player that seamlessly integrates YouTube, SoundCloud, and local files into one unified interface. Stream and manage your music from multiple platforms with shuffle, repeat, and system tray support.

repos.name: TEA-TikTok-Engagement_Analyzer
repos.description: 📊 A powerful Python tool for TikTok creators to analyze post engagement rates, track performance metrics, and identify high-performing content patterns. Features headless mode, bulk analysis, and engagement benchmarking.

repos.name: BrandFolderForge
repos.description: 🎨 Instantly generate a comprehensive brand asset directory structure. Perfect for agencies, designers, and brand managers. Creates organized folders for marketing, web, staff portals, and brand assets with one command.

result.confidenceCaveat: Public GitHub API only. No private repos, no secrets, no email harvesting. Profile data reflects GitHub public disclosure.
